lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A recurring matrix of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with vertical spacing between blobs appearing greater than horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a localized shadow-cast gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin displays a high-density cluster of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more irregularly spaced than the blobs on the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition in patterning is visible on the rostrum, where high-luminance spots decrease in diameter and increase in spatial frequency compared to the posterior regions.
